method: FX contract: alpha = classes of the categorical soft-label master (tone-group version, label-exact centres), identical for every CLUT with the same transparent entries; RGB free of class thresholds = continuous index field t (normalised convolution of the native index inside the opaque silhouette, sigma 0.55 texel: low frequencies locked to native) + band-limited turbulence (0.35 index steps) when the CLUT is a luminance ramp (Spearman >= 0.85), else categorical soft labels; glow break (new in v2): where two adjacent native indices are joined by a palette path that leaves the straight colour segment between them by more than 48 RGB under any rendered CLUT (an off-ramp entry, e.g. the grey-brown index 0 next to the red ramp on AFCCB3B5), the render uses the crisp categorical labels instead of the continuous index (soft weight over about half a texel), so no false bright halo appears between unrelated tones; per 32x32-texel cell light-energy gate vs native, applied as a smooth gain field (new in v2: per-cell log-gains bilinear between cell centres, 4 iterations, gains clamped 0.5..2; cells that are all black natively are zeroed hard because their light is only leakage), so no straight brightness step appears at cell borders inside a sprite. No material layer and no generated detail in this revision.
render_formula: t = smoothed native index (+ turbulence); rgb = lerp(P[floor t], P[ceil t]) inside the opaque silhouette, blended with the categorical label render by the glow-break weight (master/<TEX>-glowweight16-u8.npy); class = class(P[l_0]) of the soft-label master; smooth per-cell energy gain field; class stamped at every texel centre

class_validation.convention: class at pixel floor((i+0.5)*scale) of every native texel == class(CLUT[native index]); class 0 = raw 0x0000, 255 = STP, 127 = opaque

alpha_channel: categorical PSX classes (0 = raw 0x0000, 127 opaque, 255 STP), NOT opacity; exact at every native texel centre

glow.used: glow with break weight (labels where the index path leaves the colour segment)
glow with break weight (labels where the index path leaves the colour segment)

honest_read: Class-exact: 0 class mismatches in 4 exports; alpha comes from the categorical master, so transparency is identical for every CLUT with the same transparent entries.

Flames, smoke and red puffs become smooth continuous-index gradients with gentle band-limited turbulence. They read as soft and glowing, which suits smoke. At 16x they are clearly soft, not crisp sprite art.
Small spiky sprites (the mine/star row at the bottom of B305DC32) lose their crisp silhouettes and become soft blobs at 16x. At in-game size they are acceptable but softer than native.

AFCCB3B5: index 0 (grey-brown) is off the red ramp. In the first v2 build the continuous index drew a bright pink halo wherever index 0 met the dark reds. The glow-break weight now renders those 2738 texels with crisp categorical labels, and the halo is gone.

Turbulence (0.35 index steps) also mottles flat fillers: the grey-brown field on AFCCB3B5 gets faint pink mottle from index 1, and the light-grey filler on B305DC32 gets grey mottle. This matters only if those fillers are drawn (unknown until AQ-03).

The light-energy gate is a smooth gain field (gains 1.0..1.48). Every cell lands within 3 % of native mean light, and no straight brightness step remains at the 32-texel cell borders. The old scalar gate left 7-18 % steps there. Two cells that are all black natively are zeroed: their light was only leakage from neighbours.
No generated detail: the planned FX v2 SDXL img2img pass for these pages has not run.
